thread.title: Windows shattered as Apple, Google shuttle buses targeted on freeway

author: morningstar.com
title: Windows shattered as Apple, Google shuttle buses targeted on freeway
text:
By Mike Murphy
5 buses hit by vandals Tuesday
Five charter buses shuttling workers for Apple Inc. and Google were the apparent targets of vandalism Tuesday, resulting in shattered windows but no injuries.
Four of the buses were carrying Apple (AAPL) employees and the fifth carried employees of Alphabet Inc.'s (GOOGL) (GOOGL) Google, officials said. The two tech giants are among a number of companies that provide free shuttles from San Francisco to their offices in Silicon Valley.
The windows were damaged while the buses were driving on Interstate 280 near the town of Woodside, between San Francisco and Apple's Cupertino, Calif., headquarters, authorities told the San Jose Mercury News (https://www.mercurynews.com/2018/01/17/apple-google-shuttle-buses-targeted-on-highway-280/). The attacks happened during both the morning and evening commutes, and passengers were on board each bus.
The California Highway Patrol suspects pellet guns or rocks were used.
"We know it's not a high-powered rifle or anything like that," one officer told the Mercury News. "The outside glass of the window broke, but the object didn't go into the bus."
While the chartered buses are common sights on Bay Area freeways, the buses are not marked with either Apple or Google logos, so authorities said it's unlikely they were specifically targeted.
Apple re-routed some of its buses Wednesday, according to an internal email obtained by Mashable (http://mashable.com/2018/01/17/apple-shuttle-attacks/?utm_cid=hp-n-1#5zbHccAC8mq0).
"Due to recent incidents of broken windows along the commute route, specifically on highway 280, we're re-routing coaches for the time being. This change in routes could mean an additional 30-45 minutes of commute time in each direction for some riders," the email said.
In recent years, tech shuttles in San Francisco and Oakland have been vandalized by protesters (https://www.theverge.com/2013/12/20/5231758/protesters-target-silicon-valley-shuttles-smash-google-bus-window), who view them as symbols of gentrification and income inequality.
-Mike Murphy;
